reason: The README describes a DSH plugin for managing multiple OpenAI Codex subscriptions, authenticating accounts, selecting OpenAI Codex as a provider, and adding web search and image generation, so external-services is the primary category.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中管理多个 OpenAI Codex 订阅账户，并提供登录、模型提供商选择、网页搜索和图像生成工具。
summaries.en: Manage multiple OpenAI Codex subscriptions in DeepSeek Harness with account login, provider selection, web search, and image generation tools.
